cands.bio: Republican state representative for Alabama House District 94 (Baldwin County) since November 2022. Former public works director for the City of Fairhope and former member of the Fairhope Planning Commission. Founded Fidler Consulting. Holds a horticulture degree from Auburn and a master's in education from Troy State.
cands.gaps: We found no official records of the bills she sponsored or how she voted, so the legislative actions described here come only from her campaign site. We found no stated position from her on data centers, homestead property tax elimination, limits on out-of-state or foreign land buyers, immigration or H-1B, gun laws, or school choice and teacher pay. We found no specific development or rezoning decisions from her time on the Fairhope Planning Commission. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for her in 2026. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. The year she moved back to Baldwin County after working in Eufaula is cut off in the campaign biography we could read. We found no documented controversies or foreign ties.
